analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Iss site ke liye live, public analytics, scratch se banaya gaya, cookieless, aur private by construction.
analytics.lead: Neeche ka har number ek first-party tracker, ek Postgres events table, aur ek Redis cache se aata hai, sab iss site ke liye banaye gaye hain. Public on purpose: measuring product ka hi part hai.
analytics.topSections: Attention ke hisaab se top sections
analytics.topSectionsSummary: Visitors ne har homepage section par screen par kitna total time spend kiya.
analytics.scrollDepthSummary: Visitors homepage par kitna neeche scroll karte hain.
analytics.clickMapSummary: Visitors homepage par kahan click karte hain, ek snapshot par overlaid.
analytics.emptyState: Abhi koi data nahi. Yeh dashboard tab bharega jab log visit karenge.
analytics.privacyHeading: Main kya measure karta hoon, aur kya nahi
privacyMeasure: Pageviews, sections dekhe gaye, scroll depth, aur clicks, aggregated
Device class, OS, browser, aur country (request header se, IP se kabhi nahi)
Anonymous per-tab session ids jo khud rotate aur expire hote hain
privacyNot: Koi cookies nahi, koi fingerprinting nahi, koi cross-site kuch bhi nahi
Koi naam, emails, ya koi personal data nahi: unhe store karne ki koi jagah nahi hai
Koi raw IP addresses nahi: schema mein unke liye koi column nahi hai
Do Not Track aur Global Privacy Control ka sammaan kiya jaata hai: tracking bas kabhi shuru nahi hoti
